profile.headline: What is your data trying to tell you?
profile.summary:
I'm an expert Data Integration Architect with a passion for knowledge and learning. My skill set includes Informatica, Oracle, SQL Server, IT Strategy, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Data Analysis and Business Intelligence. I am a goal-oriented team player with an excellent work ethic and proven ability to design and develop scalable, reliable, and efficient integration and warehousing solutions. 

My subject areas of expertise include EHR, Supply Chain Management, Project Financials, HR, Document Management, CRM, as well as Clinical Healthcare and Trial Management. My strengths include gathering, documenting, and implementing system and business requirements, with excellent communication skills and collaboration with technical, managerial, and executive level team members.

I love data's ability to answer questions, surface insights, and drive decisions. Collect, integrate, and present it correctly, and you can answer the questions you aren't even asking yet. My goal is to help others listen to their data and make the tough business decisions necessary to gain competitive advantages.  

When I'm not playing with data, you can find me either enjoying the outdoors, coaching one of my kids' sports teams, or complaining about the Redskins.
